The Chicago Bears host the Philadelphia Eagles at Soldier Field in Week 3. Philadelphia beat Tennessee 24-20 behind Jalen Hurts, who hit Darius Cooper for a TD with nine seconds left, while Chicago seeks to recover from a recent loss to Minnesota.
